strings.en:
Good, good.{07:14}{1a}That Gaius fella, see, can go five days

strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Gaius the Swordsmith 】{0b:09}
Besides, the issue is not money. I
refused for two reasons.{1a}First... the smith here has no interest in
tools for protecting human life.{1a}A few times I have made them on a whim,
with no thrill at all.{1a}How swiftly to sever the foe's life: that
alone concerns me. Whether the owner
lives or dies is no affair of mine.{1a}And second: from the grating of its
metal, what you hold is common chain
mail,{1a}and in armor built for ease of movement
and mass production, no amount of
improvement yields more than a trifling
defense. I will not take on dull work.{0c:29082c091501}
strings.tl: Besides, the issue is not money. I refused for two reasons. // First... the smith here has no interest in tools for protecting human life. // A few times I have made them on a whim, with no thrill at all. // How swiftly to sever the foe's life: that alone concerns me. Whether the owner lives or dies is no affair of mine. // And second: from the grating of its metal, what you hold is common chain mail, // and in armor built for ease of movement and mass production, no amount of improvement yields more than a trifling defense. I will not take on dull work.
